# Brand voice guidelines

**Turn your best posts into a voice guide, per-platform rules and a review an agent runs on every draft.**

Derives a written brand voice guide from an account's existing posts instead of from adjectives — measures the voice with a script (length, case, punctuation, emoji, signature words, openers), reads it for traits, tone dials and vocabulary, writes do/don't pairs and per-platform adjustments (X, Threads, Bluesky, Farcaster, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Telegram, newsletter), encodes the checkable parts in a voice-rules.json, and gives agents an enforce-voice review they run on every draft (a lint script plus a checklist) before preview and human approval. Use when an AI character, agent, creator or brand needs a voice guide, when drafts "don't sound like us", when onboarding a new writer or agent, or when posts drift across platforms.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Grow](../README.md) | intermediate | 2 hours to build, 1 min per draft to review | `@useclaudia/social` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-12 |

## How it works

1. Collect the corpus
2. Measure the fingerprint
3. Read for traits, dials and vocabulary
4. Write the guide
5. Set per-platform adjustments
6. Encode the checkable rules
7. Review every draft for voice
8. Calibrate with a blind test
9. Version and maintain

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/brand-voice-guidelines.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/brand-voice-guidelines.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/brand-voice-guidelines.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/brand-voice-guidelines.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill brand-voice-guidelines`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `brand-voice-guidelines.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/brand-voice-guidelines`.
